newsitem.title: LEBANON: BLC steady, Solidere mixed on Beirut market.
newsitem.headline: BLC steady, Solidere mixed on Beirut market.

text.p: Shares of Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce held steady on lower turnover and Solidere shares were mixed on higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday.

BLC shares were unchanged from Friday's $12.25 on trade of 6,063 shares against 22,500. Also 4,337 BLC shares changed hands at $12.25 in a block trade inside the bourse hall against 12,500 on Friday at $12.125.
BLC is the first commercial bank to list on the Beirut exchange since the market reopened a year ago. The shares had risen steadily since listing on the market on December 30.
Solidere A shares were unchanged from $11 and B shares rose to $11.50 from $11.25.
Turnover in Solidere more than doubled to 62,400 shares from 25,340 on Friday and value was $683,468.75 from $282,020.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.95 percent to 941.97
